scripts.build: rimraf lib && tsc -p tsconfig.json && rimraf lib/__tests__ lib/__mocks__
scripts.preflight:facebook-backend: REQUIRE_FACEBOOK_DEPLOY_CONFIG=1 pnpm validate:deploy-env && pnpm test:deploy-scripts && pnpm audit:facebook-exports && pnpm check:types && pnpm lint && pnpm test --runInBand && pnpm build
scripts.preflight:reddit-backend: REQUIRE_REDDIT_DEPLOY_CONFIG=1 pnpm validate:deploy-env && pnpm test:deploy-scripts && pnpm audit:reddit-exports && pnpm check:types && pnpm lint && pnpm test --runInBand && pnpm build
scripts.test: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--experimental-vm-modules" FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8099 pnpm jest --config jest.config.js
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--experimental-vm-modules" FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8099 pnpm jest --config jest.config.js --runInBand --coverage
scripts.test:scalability:coverage: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--experimental-vm-modules" FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8099 pnpm jest --config jest.scalability-coverage.config.js --runInBand
scripts.test:race:coverage: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--experimental-vm-modules" FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8099 pnpm jest --config jest.race-coverage.config.js --runInBand
scripts.race:content:author: pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/race-content-author.js
scripts.race:content:dry-run: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/race-content-dry-run.js
scripts.race:content:import: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/race-content-import.js
scripts.race:content:validate-live: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/race-content-validate-live.js
scripts.race:translations:generate: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/race-content-translate.js
scripts.race:translations:audit: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/race-translation-audit.js
scripts.race:translations:import: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/race-translation-import.js
scripts.youtube:content:author: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/youtube-content-author.js
scripts.youtube:content:append: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/youtube-content-author.js --require-append
scripts.usernames:migrate: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-functions-node.js scripts/migrate-username-reservations.js
scripts.test:race:rules: node scripts/prepare-deploy.js && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage,database "pnpm jest --config jest.rules.config.js --runInBand"
